# TabStrip

The browser tab strip sits on surface-inverse (black architecture).

`PhantomPortals.TabStrip` · Browser Shell

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.TabStrip tabs={…} activeId="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.TabStrip" tabs="{{…}}" active-id="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Chromium-style tab strip on black. Middle-click closes.
